paper_title: A dissemination workshop for introducing different algorithms for sentence generation
core_problem: Determining the most likely ordering for a sentence given a set of words, especially when semantics are not accessible to simple NLP algorithms.
methodology_summary: A workshop activity inspired by the word salad puzzle, where participants rearrange tokens (on cards/bracelets) based on bigrams' distribution in a corpus to form valid sentences.
empirical_results: The workshop was adapted across various formats and time-slots (30 to 90 minutes).
explicit_limitations: The core approach remained the same across all events, but materials were adapted.
